fields.title: 📖 Speak good or remain silent
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **adab** shows itself on the **tongue**: not every word deserves to be spoken. Whoever wants to protect his **īmān** guards his speech and chooses ***good or silence***.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Adab, Bāb: Man kāna yuʾminu bi-Allah wa’l-yawm al-ākhir fa-lā yuʾdhī jārah, Hadith Nr. 6018; auch bei Muslim Nr. 47.
